title: How to Be Normal for Beginners
description: Are you tired of being called a freak? Do people throw you out of their homes? Well, do they? Let’s go on a journey into normality.
quote: Here is your typical average Joe on his way to work. See how he is dressed. Even his hair is boring.
alt1: basic blonde fish guy in work attire standing in the doorway of a house
alt2: rows of cubicles, each with the same looking fish guy working in it
alt3: nametag: Hello my name is Mr. Normal
alt4: two identical fish guys holding coffee and about to pass each other in the office
